story: Ask HN: Do you believe we'll ever encounter aliens?
text: Check out this video from the American Museum of Natural History: [VIDEO] - It makes me think that we cannot be the only society in the universe - But it also makes be think that it is unlikely that we will find them in the near future or vice versa

story: The scale of the universe, and everything
